sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the create form
sections.what: Brings in the tools for the form, the navigation, the case creation function, and the language labels.
sections.why: Needed to show the form, save the case, and move to the new case page.

sections.name: CreateCase (part 1)
sections.title: Form state and one-click demo fill
sections.what: Holds the values typed into each field and the pending and error state. The one-click button fills all fields with sample values.
sections.why: Lets a user try the app quickly without typing every field.
sections.watch_out: The one-click fill overwrites anything the user has already typed.

sections.name: CreateCase: if
sections.title: Checking, rewriting, and creating the case
sections.what: On submit, checks the required fields, rewrites khata and khesra into the DEMO- form, adds the word Demo to names that lack a demo word, then calls the create function. On success it opens the new case, and on failure it shows the error.
sections.why: Makes all created cases clearly marked as demo data, according to the code.
sections.watch_out: The rewriting changes real identifiers, so the saved values may not match the source record.

sections.name: CreateCase (part 3)
sections.title: Location fields
sections.what: Draws the district, circle, and village fields, each marked as required and linked to the error message.
sections.why: Collects the location used to find the parcel.
sections.watch_out: Only the browser checks these fields are filled. The server must check them too.

sections.name: CreateCase (part 4)
sections.title: Record fields and submit button
sections.what: Draws the khata, khesra, and nickname fields, a help note about khata, and the submit button, which is disabled while the case is being created.
sections.why: Collects the land record identifiers and prevents double submission.
sections.watch_out: The khesra field is optional, so a case may be created without it.

sections.name: CreateCase (part 5)
sections.title: Safety note and form close
sections.what: Shows a safety note under the form and closes the form and page.
sections.why: Reminds the user about how the data is handled before they submit.

summary: A form for creating a new case from location and land record numbers. It rewrites the numbers and names so they look like demo data.
purpose: Lets the user start a new case from the screen.
why: Likely reason: this is a demo app, and the form forces demo wording so that the data is clearly marked as demo.
how: The user fills in district, circle, village, khata, optional khesra, and a nickname, or uses a one-click fill. On submit, the form checks required fields, adds a DEMO- prefix to khata and khesra, adds the word Demo to names that lack a demo word, calls the create function, and opens the new case.
inputs: Typed values, the one-click demo values, and the chosen language.
outputs: A new case that opens automatically, or an error message.
risks: Khata and khesra values are changed, so a real number can be saved with a different value than the user typed. Names are also changed to add Demo, which can make real names incorrect.
debug: If creation fails, read the error text and check the create function. If a saved number differs from the typed one, check the normalization step, which removes characters and adds the prefix. If a name has an unexpected suffix, check the demo word rule.
